admission.justification: Parsed pins and observed installation checks prevent testing one host release while accidentally launching another tag or range.

applicability: Parsing and provisioning the configured Paseo release.
exclusions: Historical F26 final activation/version-check limits are not certified as atomic.
statement: The Paseo version is one exact release (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional prerelease): a range, tag, partial version, build metadata, leading `v` or padded value is refused at parse time, the install is requested as `--save-exact @getpaseo/cli@<version>`, and a prefix reporting any other version is replaced.
